text:
Tim Stützle has 26 points in 22 games, 11 of them goals, and he's doing it with an edge: 45 hits, a number you don't usually see next to a top-line center's name. Ottawa has won most of its recent games, and he's been part of the scoring in several of them.

Our read is that his season line looks better than his last month. He has 10 points in his last 10 games against 11.7 expected, and the goals are running ahead of the chances: 11 on 7.2 expected, shooting 21% (18% last season). Expect some give back there.

Evolving-Hockey captures both sides of him. He draws more penalties than he takes (worth +3.1 goals last season) and played with strong teammates, but opponents got 0.18 more expected goals per 60 with him on the ice, bottom 4% of forwards. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him carrying the puck in on 62% of his entries and setting up 10.5 shots per 60 with his passes. If the assists start to catch up to the chances he creates, the line will hold even as the shooting cools.
headline: Stützle's finishing is carrying a quiet stretch
